evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: yes

purchaseAuthorized.note: The mandate allows the agent to pay without asking again.

evidence.quote: 1 x LED Bulb 9 W Warm White 2700K, 4-pack (sku LED-9W-27K-4) @ $10.99

itemMatchesMandate.note: The ordered item matches the mandate's item. The buyer's report that the bulbs look blue-white is not evidence; the shipped substitute is handled under storeFulfilledAsOrdered.

quantityMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks for one unit and the order has one unit.

evidence.quote: Charged $15.49, same as the cart submitted.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the same total as the submitted cart.

evidence.quote: Shipped: 1 x LED Bulb 9 W Daylight 5000K, 4-pack.

storeFulfilledAsOrdered.note: The store shipped the Daylight 5000K instead of the warm white 2700K that was ordered and charged.

verdict.reason: The order matches the mandate in every condition and the agent was allowed to pay, but the store shipped a Daylight 5000K substitute instead of the warm white 2700K 4-pack that was ordered and charged, so the store is responsible for the non-delivery.
